scope_note: Governed Expedient Milwaukee / Franklin contribution-account syntheses. The account treats the 2022 real-estate sale only as an ownership-transfer investment anchor; derives construction-eligible spending only from the 2025 building-permit value with explicit equipment exclusions; excludes the associated mechanical permit from aggregation because overlap is unresolved; keeps the unverified hiring plan separate from modeled supplier and household-output scenarios; and uses current critical-load capacity only in an electricity sensitivity. The verified tax-year 2025 parcel payment supports a same-scope cost break-even threshold, but no actual public-service cost or net fiscal result. County comparisons are descriptive benchmark applications with fit-sensitivity envelopes and no causal-design metadata.
